answer: Sybil resistance comes from registering each agent public key only after remote attestation proves it was generated and retained inside an enclave with an approved MRENCLAVE measurement. A copied VM cannot reproduce that hardware-backed identity or its attestation key; creating another agent therefore requires provisioning another genuine TEE-capable silicon instance, not duplicating software across zenith, terrace, or tundra deployments. Measurement verifies code, while key custody binds identity to hardware.
